name: KeeperHub (LangChain SDK)
description: KeeperHub's full 25-tool LangChain SDK as native OpenClaw tools — DeFi protocols (Aave, Uniswap, Lido, Compound, 392 more), token transfers, ENS resolution, Chainlink price feeds, workflow generation & execution, smart contract calls, x402/MPP payments, ERC-8004 agent identity, and Chainlink CCIP across 19 blockchains.
author: Dhruv Pancholi

apiKey.description: KeeperHub API key (kh_ prefix). Get from app.keeperhub.com -> Settings -> API Keys.

testnetOnly.description: Block all mainnet write operations. Read operations always work.

allowedChainIds.description: Allowlist of chain IDs for writes e.g. ["84532", "11155111"].
